Sponsor.title: Support Notebook
Sponsor.subtitle: Every course on Notebook is free and open source. If one helped you, you can support the time that goes into writing and maintaining them.
Sponsor.githubDescription: Sponsor through your GitHub account, every month or once.
Sponsor.kofiDescription: Leave a one-time tip, or a monthly one.
Sponsor.buyMeACoffeeDescription: Buy a coffee, once or every month.
Sponsor.thanksDevDescription: Fund the open source projects your own code depends on.
Sponsor.star: Star the repository on GitHub, so more people find it.
Sponsor.contribute: Fix a mistake or improve a lesson: every page has an edit link.
Sponsor.share: Share a course with someone who's learning.

Contribute.title: Contribute to Notebook
Contribute.subtitle: Notebook is open source, and every course is a folder of Markdown files. You can fix a typo, improve a lesson, or write a new course without touching the code.
Contribute.bugText: Something on the site is broken or looks wrong.
Contribute.ideaText: A new course, a topic, or a feature you would like.
Contribute.lessonText: Every lesson has an "Edit this page on GitHub" link. Read the content guide first.
Contribute.source: This guide is {file} in the repository.

Auth.title: Sign in to Notebook
Auth.description: With an account, you can save your favorite courses and your progress on every device.
Auth.privacyNotice: When you sign in, Notebook saves the name, email, and profile picture of your account. Read the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

Account.title: My account
Account.unavailable: Accounts aren't available on this site.
Account.signedOutTitle: Sign in to see your account
Account.signedOutText: With an account, you can save favorites, progress, and preferences on every device. You don't need a password: you use an account you already have.
Account.linkedText: You can sign in with any of the linked accounts.
Account.lastIdentity: This is the only account you can sign in with. Link another one before you unlink it.
Account.preferencesText: Your language, theme, and palette are saved in your account and follow you on every device. Change them in Settings, the gear icon at the top.
Account.dataText: You can download a copy of all the data that Notebook keeps about you, or delete your account.
Account.deleteText: Your account and all its data (profile, favorites, progress, and preferences) will be deleted forever. You can't undo this.
Account.favoritesText: The courses you saved with the star. You find them on all your devices.
Account.favoritesEmpty: You have no favorite courses yet. Tap the star on a course in the <courses>overview</courses> to save it here.
Account.bookmarksText: The lessons you saved as important. You find them on all your devices.
Account.bookmarksEmpty: You have no bookmarks yet. Tap “Bookmark” on a lesson to save it here.
Account.progressText: The courses you started, with the lessons you completed and the last lesson you read.
Account.progressEmpty: You haven't started a course yet. Open a lesson and press “Mark as completed” when you finish it.
